title: FactoryReleaseReadiness
description: Output contract for the release readiness stage. Evaluates whether a factory output is safe to merge and deploy.

decision.description: pass requires score >= 4.0, no unwaived blockers, rollback plan for medium/high risk, and manual QA steps for UI changes.

release_readiness_score.description: Overall release readiness score. Must be >= 4.0 to pass.

blockers_unwaived.description: List of unresolved blocking issues. Must be empty for decision=pass.

rollback_plan_exists.description: True if a rollback plan is documented for medium/high risk changes.

manual_qa_steps_exist.description: True if manual QA steps are documented for UI-affecting changes.

migration_plan_exists.description: True if a migration plan is documented when DB migrations are present.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of release readiness state.

files_changed.description: List of files changed in this factory run.

validation_commands_passed.description: Validation commands that passed (e.g. lint, typecheck, test, build).

known_risks.description: Known risks documented by the release manager.

deployment_notes.description: Notes for the operator performing the deployment or merge.
